description: Set the bolster, took the bowl down, and did not touch the writing.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Brought the sermon home and kept the stair.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Brought the letter from the Bell and said to answer the last question first.
name: Gilbert Shakespeare

description: His hand is on the pot. His face is not in the picture.
name: William Shakespeare
